correctness.rationale: Good k-directions are exactly bases of the represented row matroid, so Xi is the base polytope intersected with the open coordinate half-box. Edmonds' rank description and box-intersection formula give the stated rank-defect criteria; strict positivity follows by a small full-support base mixture because all retained coordinates are nonloops.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The September 2026 source analyzes Xi by counting, balanced configurations, explicit empty examples, and separate rank-two arguments but does not state a matroid/base-polytope or strength characterization. Searches found no prior application giving the exact all-rank or exponent-feasibility formulas. Underlying matroid theorems are not claimed as new.

value.rationale: The result replaces several partial geometric tests by an exact criterion in every rank, describes the full Xi polytope, and removes the existential alpha from the exponent condition through explicit rank inequalities, while clearly separating this structural result from multiplier unboundedness claims.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, formal verification, or a guarantee of first discovery.
